column3: “To call all those” expands the purpose of obedience of faith among all the nations.
“Preaching” specifies the service in the gospel.
Fruit is rendered as “a harvest”; “I have had” supplies a verb for the comparison.
“The gospel” supplies the subject instead of the passive revelation of righteousness in it; “from start to finish” renders from faith to faith.
The singular likeness of an image is rendered with plural “images”; “animals” renders quadrupeds.
“Relations” specifies use; recompense is rendered as “penalty.”
